dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "This month, there were a total of eleven incidents. Nine involved damage to property and goods, and two resulted in injuries to travelers and personnel."

dialogues.speaker: Safety Notice
dialogues.text: "Both travelers and new couriers — please, always exercise caution. Avoid reckless modes of travel, choose suitable paths and climbing routes, and prioritize your safety at all times."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Alright, alright, Uncle Wayna. You've told me this umpteen times already."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Mayta, you little rascal! Just because you haven't gotten hurt yet, doesn't mean it doesn't apply to you... You of all people should be extra careful!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "No way! You have to take a few tumbles if you wanna get better, hehe!"
